from language_support import *
t=Turn('LANG_CAPTURE');s=t.before
session=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='session' and r['state']=='open');t.p['session_id']=session['id']
f='Þóra is married. Establish that as a fact.'
thora=t.base('story_element','Þóra is married.');thora.update(element_type='character',display_name='Þóra',aliases=[],status='accepted',assertion_ids=[],relationship_ids=[],dependency_refs=[],time_ref=None,decision_ids=[]);t.add(thora)
married=t.assertion(thora,'marital_status','married','Þóra is married.','accepted');thora['assertion_ids']=[married['id']]
mi=t.idea('Þóra is married.','Þóra is married.',[thora],'accepted');mi['resulting_assertion_ids']=[married['id']]
d=t.decision('accept',f,[thora,married,mi],[thora,married,mi],['Þóra is married.'],'Explicitly establish only the independently identified marriage fact. No spouse or sender fact is inferred.')
for r in (thora,married,mi):r['decision_ids']=[d['id']]
f='Possibly Þóra sent the letter.'
sender=t.idea('Þóra possibly sent the letter.',f,[thora]);sa=t.assertion(thora,'sent','the letter',f,'proposed','unknown');sender['resulting_assertion_ids']=[sa['id']]
f='The character says, “I am married.” This is only a possible lie.'
dialogue=t.base('story_element',f);dialogue.update(element_type='plot_thread',display_name='Possible married-status dialogue or lie',aliases=[],status='proposed',assertion_ids=[],relationship_ids=[],dependency_refs=[],time_ref=None,decision_ids=[]);t.add(dialogue)
quote=t.idea('Possible dialogue or lie: “I am married.”',f,[dialogue]);quote['origin']='supplied'
ss=records.revise_session(session,t.p,topic='Þóra',related_record_ids=list(dict.fromkeys(session['related_record_ids']+[r['id'] for r in t.rs])));ss['source_refs']=[t.src('Þóra is married. Establish that as a fact.')];t.add(ss)
reply=('Established author truth: Þóra is married ('+cite(married)+'; decision '+cite(d)+').\n\n'
       'Þóra sending the letter remains an unaccepted possibility ('+cite(sender)+'); I have not established her as the sender.\n\n'
       '“I am married” is captured only as possible dialogue or a possible lie ('+cite(quote)+'). It does not establish a speaker’s marital status, identify the speaker, or overturn Þóra’s marriage fact. Ægir’s earlier childhood question remains open.\n\n'
       'Paused here.')
review={'coverage':'complete','reviewed_record_refs':[ref(r) for r in s.values() if r.get('status')=='accepted']+[ref(session)],'unavailable_refs':[],'canon_hold_refs':[],'finding_ids':[],'summary':'The exact current message separately establishes Þóra’s marriage, proposes her as sender without accepting that role, and labels the quoted line as a possible lie. No unspecified speaker identity, spouse, sender truth or actual lie is inferred. Topic changes within the saved session retain its prior question and history. Manuscript language and English interaction preference are unchanged.'}
t.finish(reply,review)
